name: Terraria
description: Vanilla Terraria dedicated server. Creates the world on first start and saves it cleanly on stop.

variables.label: World name
variables.description: Letters, digits, - and _. Created on first start if it does not exist.

variables.label: World size
variables.description: Only used when the world is first created.

notes:
Runs the official dedicated server via [ryshe/terraria](https://github.com/ryansheehan/terraria) (vanilla build, no TShock).

- The world is generated on the first start; a large world takes a few minutes.
- Difficulty (classic, expert, master, journey) is not a command-line option. It only applies when a world is generated: stop the server, set `difficulty=` (0 classic, 1 expert, 2 master, 3 journey) in `serverconfig.txt`, delete the `.wld` file from the worlds volume and start it again.
- The console accepts the server's own commands: `save`, `playing`, `kick <name>`, `say <message>`… Stopping the server sends `exit`, which saves the world first.
- Max players and the password set here override `serverconfig.txt`.
